## Outcome and linked work
Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link stories, specifications, or workflow issues.

## Change class
- [ ] Planning/documentation only; no application implementation, scaffolding, or executable prototype.
- [ ] Implementation within an owner-approved scope.

For implementation: link the phase approval, owner's explicit decision, exact approved planning SHA, and covered issues. Explain any mismatch before proceeding; this PR cannot self-authorise expanded scope.

## Verification and acceptance evidence
Record checks actually run, results, and demonstrations of acceptance criteria. For documentation-only work, record consistency/readability/link checks. State remaining verification gaps and who will resolve them.

## Review and follow-up
Identify decisions needing the human owner, material risks, and separately logged follow-up work. PR creation or agent completion does not mean the story is accepted. Record release/deployment approval separately when applicable.
